statement: Let n = len(nums). For 0 <= i <= n, define L(i) = sum of nums[j] over all j with 0 <= j < i, and R(i) = sum of nums[j] over all j with i < j < n; an empty sum is 0. The function returns a result r (it does not fail), and r is the leftmost pivot index: if P = { i | 0 <= i < n and L(i) = R(i) } is nonempty, then r = min(P); if P is empty, then r = -1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4 and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[j] <= 1000.

statement: The function returns a result r; that is, the call does not fail for any input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4 and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, either r = -1 or 0 <= r < len(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4 and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, r is a pivot index: 0 <= r < len(nums) and sum_{j=0}^{r-1} nums[j] = sum_{j=r+1}^{len(nums)-1} nums[j], where an empty sum is 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4 and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = -1 if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), sum_{j=0}^{i-1} nums[j] != sum_{j=i+1}^{len(nums)-1} nums[j], where an empty sum is 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4 and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, no smaller index is a pivot: for every i with 0 <= i < r, sum_{j=0}^{i-1} nums[j] != sum_{j=i+1}^{len(nums)-1} nums[j], where an empty sum is 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4 and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if sum_{j=1}^{len(nums)-1} nums[j] = 0 (the empty sum when len(nums) = 1 is 0), then r = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4 and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if sum_{j=0}^{len(nums)-2} nums[j] = 0 (the empty sum when len(nums) = 1 is 0) and no i with 0 <= i < len(nums)-1 is a pivot index, then r = len(nums)-1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4 and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[j] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with 0 <= r < len(nums), let total = sum_{j=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[j] and let L = sum_{j=0}^{r-1} nums[j], with L = 0 if r = 0. Then 2 * L + nums[r] = total.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^4 and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[j] <= 1000.
